Messages.Author: KevinM
Messages.Body:
ORIGINS 2011 event registration is now open! Not that we'll fill up the VTES events...but we can hope for it! www.originsgames.com/

Someone alerted me to the fact that, while purchasing event tickets, he (obviously) wasn't yet sure if he was going to make the NAC Day2 or would he have to play in the Shadow Twin tournament.

My suggestion for everyone playing in the NAC Day1:
Do NOT purchase ANY tickets for the two Saturday events!

When we do the cut on Friday night, you can go buy your NAC Day2 or Shadow Twin ticket for Saturday at that time (or just give me generic tokens for it).

If you've already bought your NAC Day2 ticket and don't make the cut (or you bought your Shadow Twin ticket and DO make the cut), then just walk up to the Event Ticket booth and ask for an exchange. No problem.
